summary: Canadian Natural Resources filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2026 third quarter results (press release, MD&A, and interim financial statements for the periods ended September 30, 2026), the standard US-equivalent disclosure for a foreign private issuer reporting quarterly earnings. Q3 production totaled roughly 1,652,000 BOE/d, including a planned Horizon turnaround; thermal in situ hit a record ~300,000 bbl/d and North American conventional liquids a record ~358,000 bbl/d. No transaction, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. The filing is routine results disclosure, not a special situation.
